description: This file contains a PySide6 (Qt for Python) dialog class 'ModifiersList' used for selecting behavior modifiers within the BORIS behavioral observation software. It manages user interactions for selecting modifiers via GUI elements such as list widgets, line edits, and buttons, and handles events like key presses and button clicks. The class provides methods to retrieve selected modifiers and validate numeric inputs.

classes.name: ModifiersList
classes.description: A QDialog subclass for selecting behavior modifiers, supporting single, multi, and numeric selections, with event filtering and validation.

methods.name: __init__(self, code: str, modifiers_dict: dict, currentModifier: str)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog, creating layout, widgets, and setting up the interface based on provided modifiers dictionary and current modifier.

methods.name: eventFilter(self, receiver, event)
methods.description: Handles key press events to enable keyboard navigation and shortcuts within the dialog.

methods.name: get_modifiers(self)
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the selected modifiers from the GUI elements.

methods.name: pbOK_clicked(self)
methods.description: Validates numeric inputs and signals acceptance of the dialog if all inputs are valid.
